text: The first time we went, the service was excellent, but after several visits, we encountered various problems. For example, wires and brackets would come loose in the treatment room, and the dentist would fix it immediately by cutting the wire and telling us to come back for a second visit. We understand that there are many patients, but doing things right from the start is important. We hesitated many times to revise our review. Today, another bracket came loose, and they asked us to come back to have the wire cut again, which we had other appointments to attend to. Honestly, we understand that this is normal for orthodontic treatment, but this kind of fixing process makes us feel very disappointed.
